rule: Each block below is committed to git BEFORE the code that scores it produces a number. The commit hash of this file is the registration. Changing a block after a result exists requires a new version string, and the old block is kept.
amended_utc: 2026-11-19 (corrections block; no result had been computed)

data_ladder.train: 2025 regular season, weeks 1-9 (games strictly before the validation window)
data_ladder.validation: 2025 regular season, weeks 10-18, walked forward week by week
data_ladder.final_holdout: 2026 regular season, weeks 1-10, walked forward week by week; no 2026 result informs any earlier prediction
data_ladder.excluded: postseason, the 2026 pre-season, and any game not present in the verified results feed with an official game-centre URL
data_ladder.why_this_ladder: one full season of training, one validation block, and a final block that is never touched during selection. The 2026 block is small (150 games), so it is reported with a week-cluster interval and never as a point estimate alone.

markets.why_that_order: the side is the market with the most informative structure in this corpus (margin), the total is second, and the moneyline is a monotone transform of the same margin distribution. Publishing in that order keeps each later number anchored to an already-published one.
markets.SIDE: fair home margin in points; the win probability implied by the model's own margin distribution
markets.MONEYLINE: the same win probability expressed as a fair American price at zero margin

strategies.name: Climatology control
strategies.definition: the training-window base rate of home wins for the side/moneyline, and the training-window mean and SD of total points for the total. No team information at all.

strategies.name: Symmetric ridge team strength
strategies.definition: points = mu + offense_team - defense_opponent +/- H, with one global home advantage H. offense and defense are ridge-shrunk to zero (lambda chosen from the validation block only, from the fixed grid below).

strategies.name: Team strength + club-specific home advantage
strategies.definition: M1 with a separate home advantage per home club, shrunk toward the global H by the same ridge penalty. 32 coefficients.

strategies.name: Team strength + recency weighting
strategies.definition: M1 where each game's weight decays with the number of that club's own subsequent games, half-life 6 club-games.

strategies.name: Team strength + rest differential
strategies.definition: M1 plus a coefficient on (rest days home - rest days away), rest measured from the published gameday dates only. Coefficient shrunk to zero.

strategies.name: Equal-weight ensemble
strategies.definition: the arithmetic mean of the M1-M4 predictive distributions. Weights fixed equal; no fitting on outcomes.

selection_rule.criterion: mean proper score on the 2025 validation block only
selection_rule.side: Brier score on home-win probability; lower is better
selection_rule.total: CRPS on the total-points distribution; lower is better
selection_rule.tie_break: fewer parameters, then lower id string
selection_rule.what_is_forbidden: the 2026 final block may not be used to choose a model, a lambda, a half-life, or a market to publish. It is read once, after the choice is frozen.

scoring.side_and_moneyline: Brier score on P(home win), benchmark-relative (Brier Skill Score = 1 - BS/BS_bench)
scoring.total: CRPS of a Normal predictive distribution, and a Brier score at a pre-registered threshold tau = 44.0 total points (see corrections: the first draft of this line called 44.0 'the rounded 2025 median', which is false. The 2025 median is 45.0; 44 is the modal 2025 total, 12 of 272 games. The threshold is kept at 44.0, and the reason is corrected before any score was computed)
scoring.uncertainty: paired week-cluster bootstrap, 10,000 resamples over weeks, seed 20261119, 90% interval, one-sided p = share of resamples with skill <= 0
scoring.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni across every (model, market) pair scored in the final block, family declared before scoring
scoring.pass_gate: Holm-adjusted p < 0.10 AND the 90% week-cluster lower bound on benchmark-relative skill > 0 AND n >= 100 games

staking.rule: No stake is simulated and no ROI is published unless the price for that exact market is present in the price store with an official source URL and a timestamped capture. No assumed -110, no assumed push handling.
staking.consequence: with zero officially verified prices in the repository (see data/price_policy.json), the staking division of the leaderboard opens empty and this is published as the result, not as a gap to be filled with an assumption.

demotion.gate: a live strategy returns to paper if, over any rolling 4-week window, its benchmark-relative skill is negative at the 90% lower bound, OR if its pre-registered sample floor is breached, OR if its inputs fail the drift alarm twice in a row
demotion.effect: demotion is recorded as an event with a date and a reason; the strategy keeps its history and is not deleted

changing_our_mind.rule: every strategy entry carries a two-sided field: what evidence would promote it, and what evidence would retire it. Both sides must be numeric and pre-registered.

corrections.was: tau=44.0 described as the rounded 2025 median total
corrections.is: tau=44.0 retained; description corrected to the modal 2025 total (12 of 272 games); the 2025 median is 45.0
corrections.why_recorded: a registration is evidence; a wrong justification is corrected in place with the wrong version kept, never silently rewritten

no_lookahead.rule: a prediction for a game may use only games whose final score was published before that game's scheduled kickoff. In this corpus all inputs are prior-week final scores, so the constraint reduces to 'strictly earlier week', which is enforced in code and asserted by the verifier.
no_lookahead.known_leak_risk: the gameday field is the published scheduled date; a rescheduled game is detected only if its date differs between two captures of the same page, which this session cannot read.
